retirement_observation.program: addi x10,x0,7; ecall; nop; zero-wait external memory
retirement_observation.expected: reset bus quiet, first retirement PC 0, ECALL retires once, halted with exit=7
retirement_observation.field_semantics: When retired=0, first_pc and first_insn are sentinels, not observed CPU values.

icache_word_observation.experiment: Four independent cold requests, one per word offset, with address-dependent memory data. After acceptance the idle request address changes to the next offset; the response must still match the accepted address.

dcache_lane_observation.experiment: Cold load at word offset one, then halfword and byte stores with an immediate readback after each store. Repeat on cold stores to the second and final words of newly allocated lines. Check external refill addresses, store byte address, mask and data, plus cached data.

execution_observation.experiment: A delayed cold load with two younger independent integer operations.
execution_observation.expected: four read beats, x2=41, exit=10, five ordered retirements and a D-wait bypass event

l3_fetch_backpressure_observation.experiment: A delayed load fills the ROB while twelve independent writes arrive from fetch.
l3_fetch_backpressure_observation.expected: All sixteen instructions retire in order, with one cold refill and exit 53.

l3_rename_reuse_observation.experiment: Twelve dependent increments of x2, copy x2 to x10, then ECALL.
l3_rename_reuse_observation.expected: Fourteen ordered retirements, x2 and exit equal 12, no data memory operations.

l3_rename_allocation_observation.experiment: Allocate all eight free registers without commits, then try a nonwriter.

l3_iq_selection_observation.experiment: Select a younger ready instruction past an unready older entry, then compare age across tag wrap.

l3_redirect_observation.experiment: JAL from PC 4 to a cold instruction line at 0x20, over a wrong-path write and ECALL.
l3_redirect_observation.expected: Only PCs 0, 4, 0x20 and 0x24 retire, with their original instructions and exit=7.

l3_repeated_redirect_observation.experiment: The same JALR resolves first to 0x20 and then to 0x40, with a BTB index alias at 0x48 and a wrong-path store and ECALL on the fall-through path.
l3_repeated_redirect_observation.expected: Ten ordered retirements, three resolves/mispredicts, no writes, exit=8.

l3_memory_queue_observation.experiment: A delayed cold word load followed by a byte load from the same cache line.
l3_memory_queue_observation.expected: Five ordered retirements, x2=0x292a, exit=41, four external reads and no writes.

l3_link_recovery_observation.experiment: A cold JAL writes x5; its target reads the link immediately after recovery.
l3_link_recovery_observation.expected: Four ordered retirements and exit=11 from link 8 plus 3.

l3_lsu_completion_observation.experiment: Hold a byte store until accepted, enqueue a load on its response, then check signed byte writeback.

l3_store_writeback_observation.experiment: A delayed store completes after younger independent writes to x3 and x10.
l3_store_writeback_observation.expected: Six ordered retirements, one bus write, and x3 and exit both equal 19.

l3_predictor_training_observation.experiment: A 16-iteration backward branch loop using an already warm instruction line.
l3_predictor_training_observation.expected: 35 retirements, x1=0, ECALL at PC 0x10, halted with exit=7

repair_verification.verification: t06_load_store: x5 expected 0xffffffff got 0x808080ff; x6 expected 0xffffff80 got 0x80808080; x11 expected 0xffff80ff got 0x800080ff; x13 expected 0xffff8000 got 0x80008000 — all consistent with LB/LH sign-extension replicating the wrong bit into upper lanes.
